limitations: This is a source-only ledger. Runtime observation and production packaging remain unverified. Local pack bytes can be audited separately.
Runtime declarations, registry review, prompt lineage, and actual output bytes are independent evidence. An exact Restyle record requires both source ID and output SHA-256.

ECL PICTURE sites come from the 22-block pinned DOS census. Sites without an explicit source receipt retain unknown bank/asset identity. Receipt mappings are conditional and do not prove route reachability.
PICTURE operands are fixed at each surveyed instruction. Entry witnesses retain static path evidence. Values read dynamically remain unresolved.
COMBAT retains every distinct ordered roster reached by the bounded traversal, with one witness per entry and full retained return stacks. Duplicate paths to a roster do not create new variants.

Traversal frontiers record depth, roster and state limits and invalid, nonlocal or undecodable edges. Host effects, dynamic branch feasibility, cross-ECL transitions and campaign reachability remain outside the model.

Combat bank association is conditional on the active area disk matching the pinned ECL archive disk and the selected CPIC archive matching its runtime SHA. Picture operand identity uses its low byte, matching the VM.
Conditional picture mapping IDs require the exact original base source. Route-specific source guards and source/output load checks can still prevent replacement.
Player frame and title layer rows describe presentation slots. Only independently reviewed source frame-group semantics are carried into the report.
The current player consumer call paths were reviewed in their own contract. The earlier player coverage snapshot and pins remain historical evidence.
The demo combat fixture records 15 ordered combatant bindings and six distinct CPIC2 IDs, separate from the bounded COMBAT scan denominator. It does not establish that a browser drew those icons.

Production Restyle image availability is delegated to the pinned localAssetPack adapter/core: exact local SHA matches are required; missing images stay on each consumer fallback, and present invalid bytes fail closed. Only development may use a served-image fallback. Folder replacement or clear invalidates the prior revision so stale asynchronous reads cannot commit. This is source/test evidence, not browser runtime observation.

The selected Library AssetSource for original game archives is separate from the selected Restyle image folder. Its basename lookup uses the shallowest relative path and scan order for equal-depth collisions; Amiga adapters then verify the required archive identity and do not try every duplicate until a hash matches. The graphics-browser local archive picker serves previews only and does not populate gameplay AssetSource.

Amiga DAA decoding/admission delegates to the engine DAA loader; the pinned loader and focused admission tests are evidence for that dependency, not proof of complete browser or production-package behavior.
The CoK title intro and title menu share createCokTitleRuntime; intro wiring is a consumer dependency but adds no separate source mapping or composition count.
